queries: WITH record_shares AS (SELECT traitregistry, zoneref, traitcount, CAST(traitcount AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(SUM(traitcount) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL), compared AS (SELECT traitregistry, zoneref, traitcount, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM record_shares) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, traitcount AS feature_count, share, share - average_share AS margin_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC, traitregistry LIMIT 10;

WITH record_shares AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, CAST(traitcount AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(traitcount) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL), compared AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS margin_above_average FROM record_shares) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, traitcount AS feature_count, share, margin_above_average FROM compared WHERE margin_above_average > 0 ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH feature_shares AS (SELECT traitregistry, zoneref, traitcount, traitcount::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(traitcount) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL), compared AS (SELECT traitregistry, zoneref, traitcount, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM feature_shares) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, traitcount AS feature_count, share, share - average_share AS margin_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC, traitregistry LIMIT 10;
